name: slicer-sb3-reference-v1
declared: 2026-10-23, before any SB3 model was checkpointed, trained for 20,480 steps or evaluated on a held-out setting
hyperparameter_source: Identical to the SB3 references in experiments/run.py run_neural (MlpPolicy, cpu, seed = training seed, PPO on 4 DummyVecEnv copies), except that DQN's exploration fraction is set from absolute steps as below. Nothing is tuned.
epsilon_rule: SB3 defines exploration_fraction against total_timesteps, so it is set to 3,584 / 20,480 = 0.175: epsilon falls from 1.0 to 0.05 over the same 3,584 absolute steps as the scratch curve and the 5,120-step endpoint run (0.7 x 5,120). PPO has no budget-dependent schedule.
checkpoint_rule: A stable_baselines3 callback evaluates the model at the start of every rollout whose num_timesteps is a multiple of 1,024 (after all gradient updates for earlier steps, as in the scratch trainers) and once more after learn() returns: 21 checkpoints at 0, 1,024, ..., 20,480 on the same evolving model. Evaluation is greedy (predict deterministic=True), which draws no training random numbers.
settings_source: Copied unchanged from slicer-difficulty-v1; held-out settings choose nothing.
eval_seed_rule: Curve: 1000 + training seed on the default setting at every checkpoint, the scratch curve's 30 episodes. Held-out evaluation: 7000 + training seed on every setting, the scratch difficulty run's episodes. Episode e resets with seed (base + training seed) * 100000 + e.
anchors: Random and scripted anchors recomputed with analysis.difficulty.evaluate_anchor on the same episodes; they must equal the anchors in evidence/slicer_difficulty_20480.json.
primary_metrics: Curve: per-seed mean fruit score at each of the 21 checkpoints (evaluation seed 1000 + s), five-seed mean with the seed-level bootstrap 95% interval; mean bomb hits alongside.
Curve: first checkpoint at or above mean fruit score 5.0 per seed; seeds that never reach it are right-censored at 20,480 and never assigned that step.
Held-out: per-seed mean fruit score at 20,480 steps for the default-trained models on each setting (evaluation seed 7000 + s), seed bootstrap interval, bomb hits alongside.
secondary_metrics: anchor-normalized score and transfer gap (in-setting reference minus default-trained model) exactly as in slicer-difficulty-v1

implementation gap = SB3 mean minus scratch twin mean at 20,480 steps (sb3_dqn vs double_dqn, sb3_ppo vs scratch_ppo), on the curve episodes and on every setting for the default-trained models, with the same 2,000-resample bootstrap over the two five-seed groups; scratch values are read from the committed evidence
mean episode return reported beside fruit score, descriptive only
held-out score at every checkpoint, descriptive only; no checkpoint is selected

decision_rules.transfer_gap: 'transfer loss' if the 95% interval lies above 0, 'transfer gain' if below 0, otherwise 'no measurable difference' (not evidence of equivalence with five seeds)
decision_rules.implementation_gap: 'SB3 higher' if the 95% interval lies above 0, 'scratch higher' if below 0, otherwise 'no measurable difference'. Descriptive: network layout, time-limit bootstrapping and optimizer details differ between the implementations.

consistency_predictions: The 5,120-step checkpoint equals the independently trained 5,120-step SB3 endpoint in evidence/neural.json seed for seed, for both agents (same seeds, hyperparameters and a 3,584-step epsilon decay).
SB3 PPO's 10,240-step checkpoint equals evidence/neural_10240.json seed for seed.
SB3 DQN's 10,240-step checkpoint differs from evidence/neural_10240.json, because that run decayed epsilon over 0.7 x 10,240 = 7,168 steps.
A failed prediction is reported as a finding about the callback path; nothing is re-run or changed because of it.
tuning: None. Agents, hyperparameters, settings, seeds, budget, anchors, metrics and reading rules are frozen by this protocol; failures are reported, not re-run.
